values.value: Controller Input Animations v1.3 Instructions: 1. Place the animations file I've provided on my github in the same folder as this nodegraph in your VNyan > Items > Animations folder 2. In Vnyan Settings > Misc, scroll to the bottom and turn on capture gamepad. Restart the program 3. Set the Grey "Camera 1" node to whatever your default stream camera is. When you toggle the graph, you will switch to this cam slot. [OPTIONAL] You can modify what animations play when you press specified buttons and other graph behaviors, see below Right click on the Cyan Websocket or Hotkey node and send signal to start To stop the effect, right click the cyan Websocket or Hotkey Node and send signal again OPTIONAL: - Tweak the thumbstick movement effect by adjusting the operation values in the red/blue parameter operation nodes below By default, the left thumbstick triggers the walking animation and the right thumbstick rotates your character - Adjust the degree to which the provided animations integrate with your tracking setup using the Blend values on the animation nodes - Set both Green "Y" button filters to whatever (it plays the Green "Cartwheel" animation node by default) - Set both Yellow "Right Shoulder" button filters to whatever (it plays the Yellow "Saluting" animation node by default) - Set both Cyan " Right Trigger" button filters to whatever (it plays the Cyan "Boxing" animation node by default) - Set both Black "B" button filters to whatever (it plays the Black "Sitting on Ground" animation node by default) - Set both Grey "Left Stick" button filters to whatever (it plays the Grey "Running" animation node & only when the joystick is tilted) NOTE: It's important that each set of button filters matches. The second filter set is used when the left joystick is tilted - The other Grey "Jogging" animation node controls your walking animation when no other button is pressed - The Pink "Idle" animation node controls your idle animation - An example of additional options is available left of this message. Feel free to use it or delete it :3! Nodegraph By Berymuch (Find me on Bluesky/Twitch)

The logic built into this nodegraph lets you do some interesting things for additional control. Here is an example:This red trigger/logic will add functionality that locks the camera to the one specified even if other sources in your vnyan setup change it and ONLY if "PNGberyloaded = 0" (the PNGTuber logic that uses this parameter locks itself to a different cam slot, and this prevents a conflict). It's handy if you want to keep a consistent view and/or have effects that change your camera and you don't want to keep switching back to the one you've set for this graph.
Connect the "Trigger" node directly to the Camera node beside it, and specify a camera you'd like to use :3! ENJOY~
